statement: Tonight I want to talk about our shared priorities: better schools and safer neighborhoods for every family in this state.
My opponent and I disagree on the budget, but I respect his years of service to our state.
My opponent has failed this state for four years, and he knows it.
We cannot afford four more years of broken promises and backroom deals.
I am proud of our record on infrastructure, and I want to finish the job we started.
I look forward to a debate about ideas, not insults.
My opponent is a corrupt hack who takes money from special interests and lies to your face.
He is a disgrace to this state, and he should be ashamed of himself.
My opponent is a radical extremist who hates everything this state stands for.
He is a fraud and a crook, and the voters will see right through him.
We need a governor who works for the people, not for his own ego.
My opponent has raised your taxes twice, and he will not admit he was wrong.
Four more years of failed leadership is four years too many.
My opponent has no plan; he only has complaints.
I believe we can disagree without being disagreeable, and I will lead with respect.
My door is always open to anyone who wants to work together on our state's future.
We have cut red tape and grown jobs, and I want to keep that momentum going.
My opponent's attacks say more about him than they say about me.
The governor talks about results, but working families are still struggling to get by.
I will fight for the people this administration has left behind.
My opponent is a flip-flopping phony with no real convictions.
He changes his positions to match the polls; you cannot trust a word he says.
I will run a campaign on the issues and let the voters decide.
This state deserves a governor who tells you the truth, even when it is hard.
